groups.why: Both check the same thing: pressing Save/OK in the column/measure setting popup with no changes must not trigger a re-search.
All check that the measure setting order is saved and that search results show measures in that saved order.
Both check that a user with no saved personalization sees the selected Div's UI Category default columns and measures after switching Div.
Checks required-column red marking and the warning message while switching Div 40→81→40, so the state differs from V-6a9be0b7 and it stays alone.
Adds an extra expectation that selected columns always appear in search results and has no Div-switch condition, so it is not grouped with V-2bc96684.
Checks that each Div's required columns stay after saving personalization in another Div, which is a different state and expectation.
Checks several screen-wide items at once (Default restore, keeping the new tab, required-column highlight, no re-search), so it does not match any single row.
Checks only that the Default button in the Column Setting popup restores the default columns.
Checks keeping the new tab after save, close and reopen, and that Default means the original default, which is a different sequence and expectation.
Checks that the grid columns rebuild immediately when OK is pressed in column setting.
Checks that the search grid follows the column settings and that internal columns such as COL_LIST are hidden.
Checks a compound expectation for a specific date range: row count matches AS-IS, Team shows the name, and the saved column popup layout is used.
Checks that the setting popup's candidate list is re-fetched for the auto-selected Division right after entering the screen, before Search.
Expects the Measure Setting button to be removed, which is a different expectation from the other rows.
Checks which measures appear in the list for each Div (unused ones removed, VMI added, MKT FCST AMT removed).
Checks that the measure name shows as MKT FCST[R+P].
Checks that VERSION is removed from the setting list and that AS FROM SITE is hidden for Div 40, both specific columns.
Checks the Column button state after save under condition EG395, which is a different element and state.
